people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

translations.web: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
translations.bsb: After Absalom had fled and gone to Geshur, he stayed there three years.
translations.kjv: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
translations.asv: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
